Bill.BriefDescription: Requiring state ferries to fly the American flag.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to display of the United States flag; and amendingRCW 1.20.015.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 1.20.015 and 1955 c 88 s 1 are each amended to read asfollows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The flag of the United States and the flag of the state shall beprominently installed, displayed and maintained in schools, courtrooms, ((and)) state buildings, and ferry vessels operated by thedepartment of transportation.
